name: Israel Museum
scope: The present Israel Museum campus exterior in Jerusalem, including the original terraced gallery pavilions, 2010 visitor circulation pavilions, named northern pavilion and Shrine of the Book with its pool and basalt wall.

originalReview.notes: The photograph shows the full double-curved white tiled shell, circular plinth, narrow neck and top ring, stone pool curb and fountain jets. The exact photographer original also matches the reviewed Commons transfer. The model uses it for external proportions.
